coverage_requirement: Produce exactly 10 distinct directions spanning different mechanism families. If two ideas fall in the same family, they must attack different bottlenecks and expose different experiments.
direction_families: KV-cache reuse or cross-token state sharing
KV-cache compression, eviction, or memory layout optimization
attention sparsity, head skipping, or token pruning
early exit, adaptive depth, or layer skipping
hardware-software co-design, batching, or kernel fusion
runtime routing or input-adaptive inference control
hard_constraints: No retraining, finetuning, distillation, or extra alignment training.
Each direction must include a concrete mechanism and a falsifiable validation plan.
Each direction must name the primary bottleneck it addresses: compute, memory bandwidth, latency, cache pressure, or verification overhead.
Each direction must justify novelty beyond plain MTP-like speculative decoding.
avoid: Generic quantization-only ideas without a new runtime mechanism.
Near-duplicate speculative decoding variants that only swap the draft model.
Broad hardware recommendations without algorithmic details.
Directions that require custom training data or offline policy learning.
success_metrics: Scalability across sequence length or model size
